purpose: Personal account of migrating and automating the DataTalks FAQ

required_facts.fact: DataTalks courses have run recurring cohorts since 2021.
The first FAQ was shared Google Docs.
Alex Litvinov's bot answered in Slack using RAG.
Google Docs were parsed from DOCX into JSON.
A custom generator produced Jekyll-like static pages with Jinja2.
The bot uses GitHub Issues and pull requests for contributions.
Fred Pearce built the GitHub Actions orchestration.

author_attribution: Keep Alexey's migration work distinct from Alex Litvinov's and Fred Pearce's contributions.
